item: Permits closed and final inspections passed (list each permit)
Equipment list: tag, make, model, serial, location
Manufacturer manuals (paper set on site and PDF set)
Warranty registrations submitted; start dates recorded
As-built drawings or marked-up sketches with isolation points
Valve tags and equipment labels installed and matching the as-builts
Owner staff training done; sign-in sheet attached
Punch list issued, with owner role and target date per item
Area cleaned; ceiling tiles, access panels and roof hatch restored
Turnover acceptance form issued for owner signature
Domestic water piping pressure test (medium, pressure, hold time per spec/code)
Drain, waste and vent test (method per spec/code)
Potable water system flushed; disinfection done where required, results attached
Backflow preventers tested by a certified tester; test reports attached
Water heater: T&P relief valve installed and piped to an approved termination
Water heater: thermostat or mixing valve set to the specified delivery temperature; reading recorded
Fuel gas piping pressure test and inspection record
Fixture operation checked (flow, drainage, no leaks), each fixture
Floor drains and trap primers working
Grease interceptor or oil/sand separator (if in scope): inspection access, baffles, first cleaning schedule
Isolation valves operate and are accessible
Equipment set per manufacturer clearances; curbs and supports secured
Refrigerant circuit: pressure test, evacuation and charge recorded (EPA 608 certified technician)
Refrigerant type and charge weight labeled on the unit
Start-up per manufacturer checklist; start-up sheet attached
Electrical: voltage and amps per phase recorded against nameplate
Condensate drain and trap installed; overflow or float switch tested
Filters installed (size and rating recorded); spare set on site if in scope
Economizer and outside air damper operation checked (if equipped)
Thermostat or BMS control: setpoints, schedules and alarms verified
Airflow / test and balance report attached (if in scope)
Gas-fired heat section: combustion and manifold pressure recorded (if equipped)
Piping pressure test (medium, pressure, hold time, result per spec)
System flushed and cleaned; strainers cleaned after flush
Fill fluid recorded: water or glycol type and concentration (refractometer reading)
Water treatment or inhibitor added; test kit reading recorded
Air removed; air separator and vents working
Expansion tank pre-charge checked and recorded before fill
System fill pressure (cold) recorded at the gauge
Pumps: rotation, amps, differential pressure; flow recorded
Boiler: start-up, combustion test, safeties and low-water cutoff tested
Supply and return temperatures at design conditions or as tested
Balancing valves set; balancing report attached (if in scope)
Ground loop (ground-source): loop flushed and purged; loop pressure and flow recorded; loop field map with header location
Heat pump: entering and leaving fluid temperatures in heating and cooling modes
Freeze protection and low-flow safeties tested
Controls sequence of operation tested; alarm points verified to the owner's alarm path
